releaseNotesSummary: Unsigned pre-1.0 release package with the #348 PASS4 hardening wave: owner-mapping warnings now appear in scan_events.csv, headers-only owner-mapping files warn instead of disappearing silently, owner-mapping export validation avoids loading items.csv unless share-level pattern checks miss, review-decision ReviewedAt precedence is normalized to UTC, local target-path scans prefer non-special SMB shares over admin shares when both match, and scans record when multiple local shares or only a special/admin share match the same path. The release also carries the guided ownership context ingestion work from #346, including optional ownership_context.csv, ownership_relationships.csv, and ownership_import_manifest.csv support. The package includes the built PowerShell module files, startup launcher, diagnostic scripts, documentation, hashes, release manifest, dependency-age report, and prebuilt standalone dashboard template assets.
